# Assets · Logos

3 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for dalan-mark-dark.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

Three nested arches with a saffron doorway. `dalan-mark-dark.svg` is for dark grounds (cream arches), `dalan-mark-light.svg` for light grounds (ink arches), `dalan-mark-on-saffron.svg` for saffron fills (all ink). In the product the mark is inline SVG so the doorway can take the active node accent. Minimum 16 px; clear space is the doorway width.
